chapter: Opening and the early lawn-party bands
title: Recording setup and introductions at Vincent's house
summary: The interviewer states the date, 21 January 1960, and the four people present: Vincent, Punch Miller, Paul Crawford and Dick Allen. Miller relays questions, starting with Bab Frank.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: We're recording this at Little Dad's house, Clarence Vincent's house. And today is January the what?
Today is the 21st of January, by the Stonewall Jackson's birthday, 1960. And I guess we better get everybody's name here. Give me your name, huh?
What's your name? You. Clarence Vincent.
Paul Crawford. And Dick Allen. Four of us, yeah. He wanted to talk about Bab Frank. Ask him about Bab.
